item.text:
Migrated the project to App Router while preserving the existing UI and content.

- Added [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx) and [app/about/page.tsx](/workspace/app/about/page.tsx).
- Added [app/layout.tsx](/workspace/app/layout.tsx) with `<html lang="en">`, `<body>`, and shared metadata.
- Replaced `next/head` with metadata exports and navigation anchors with `next/link`.
- Removed `pages/`, including `_app.tsx` and `_document.tsx`.
- Updated TypeScript configuration and ignored generated Next.js files.

Verified that `npm run build` passes, including TypeScript checks. Production-server checks confirmed both pages return HTTP 200 with the expected content, metadata, and links. The existing `/contact` links still return 404 because no Contact page exists.
